details.name: Lifeng
details.quote: Hey Endministrator, it's me, Lifeng! I'm still a bit green, but I'll work super hard! They say hardships shape and perfect us, but what does perfection really look like? Maybe someone like you has the answer. I'd really appreciate your insights.
details.infection: Oripathy positive (infected), based on medical examination reports.
details.exp1d: Agility: Xiranite Powered A lad equipped with the latest experimental Xiranite prosthetic. His chrome features great power, speed, and sensitivity.
details.exp2d: Natural Lore: Planter To people who share his childhood, nurturing of life seems like second nature.
details.hb1d: Sports: Martial Meditation An aspiring traveler needs mental and physical fortitude. One needs a strong body to travel far.
details.hb2d: Nature: Keen Traveler Much of this world remains unknown to him. Nevertheless, he regards these mysteries as future duties that he must try to live up to.
